dedupe_keys.name: village level flood forecast dashboard myanmar hdp partner product hosted by mimu

description: The Village-level Flood Forecast Dashboard, hosted by the Myanmar Information Management Unit, gives flood risk forecasts for the week ahead for covered villages in Rakhine, Ayeyarwady, southern Shan, Kayah and Kayin, refreshed daily. Rainfall forecasts from the ECMWF high-resolution model are run against village-specific flood thresholds derived from hydrological modelling of terrain, soils and river networks, giving a flood risk score built from shallow, moderate and deep flood probabilities, a risk level from low to very high, a forecast confidence and 5- and 7-day accumulated rainfall. It is a product of a humanitarian partner organisation using analytics by GreenAnt B.V. Coverage is covered villages in five states and regions of Myanmar. Access is free online behind a username and password, with access given on request. Caveats: the page states it is not an official forecast or warning, is provided as is, and may not be used commercially; the data were not viewed because they need a login. Simulation uses: anticipatory action and exposure of village infrastructure to riverine flooding. Related records: the Myanmar river water level dashboard (data-myanmar-river-water-level-dashboard-mimu).
